headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2024: the ROH World Heavyweight Title found a new home as Chris Jericho vs. Mark Briscoe battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.18 ? ending the champion's reign at 16 defenses. In a bloody Ladder War pitting a legend against a hungry young star, Jericho climbed past a battered Briscoe to pull down the belt and win the ROH World Championship.
It was 2019 when The Lucha Brothers vs. Private Party met in a Tournament Match, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 8.02 ? an excellent showing.
It was 2021 when Bryan Danielson vs. Dustin Rhodes crossed paths for the first time ever, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.89 ? a solid showing.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2019, when Jon Moxley vs. PAC headlined Dynamite, rated 7.41 ? a well-worked match in a hard-fought men's division clash.
Looking back to 2024, when it was Kamille's first night in AEW against Queen Aminata, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.17.
Back on this day in 2019, Jamie Hayter laced up for their first AEW match against Britt Baker, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.79.
